November 11, 2026


Cameco’s community relations liaisons play an important role in connecting northern communities with information, resources and opportunities. Recently our liaison Victor Fern Sr. met with Grades 10, 11 and 12 students at Father Gamache Memorial School in Fond du Lac to talk about Cameco and Orano, uranium mining, scholarships, mine tours and the many career paths available in the mining industry. Through regular school visits like this, our liaisons build relationships with students, answer questions and help young people understand the opportunities available to them close to home.[#CommunityRelations](https://facebook.com/hashtag/CommunityRelations) #NorthernSaskatchewan[#MiningCareers](https://facebook.com/hashtag/MiningCareers)
